description: Border-radius values actually observed in source, ranked by usage frequency across sections.json evidence gathered during this build.

card-sm.note: rounded-2xl (Tailwind default 1rem), used on blog cards / feature images.

card-lg.note: rounded-3xl (Tailwind default 1.5rem), used on Stack panels, use-case cards, prefooter, demo form.
